name: dropbeam
description: Peer-to-peer file transfer in the browser: any size, any device, no upload server.

scripts.typecheck: cd packages/protocol && bun run typecheck && cd ../transfer && bun run typecheck && cd ../../apps/signaling && bun run typecheck && cd ../web && bun run typecheck
scripts.lan: cd apps/web && bun run build && cd ../signaling && WEB_ROOT=../web/dist bun run start
